userStories.title: Enforce spool message attestation checks
userStories.description: As a coordinator operator, I need attestation-required messages to be validated so untrusted task completions do not advance the FSM.

userStories.title: Implement per-task halt and resume handling
userStories.description: As an operator, I need HALT.<task_id> and X-Resume-Action support so risky tasks can be isolated and resumed safely.
userStories.evidence: coord-tick-test 7/15/16/16b/16c/18 pass: HALT file -> halted; retry resume clears halted task; abort resume keeps task halted; retry resume clears per-task halt without global HALT; retry-as-role clears per-task halt; HALT message with X-Resume-Tag does NOT auto-resume on next tick (bug fixed in process-resume-actions: skip messages with Subject: [HALT]).

userStories.title: Apply bounded retry policy with escalation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need retries capped with backoff and escalation so blocked work does not loop forever.
userStories.evidence: coord-tick-test.nu tests 8/9/10/13 pass (fail on first attempt -> retry dispatched, no global HALT; attempt counter increments on fail; retry exhausted -> HALT file created; blocked+no-unblocker -> immediate HALT, no retry); coord-escalate-test.nu 13/13 pass via run-all.sh; sh tests/run-all.sh -> "results: 10 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed".

userStories.title: Add capability gate checks during dispatch
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I need tools_required to be checked against AGENT_CAPABILITIES so tasks are sent only to capable agents.
userStories.evidence: coord-tick-test.nu test 11 passes (capability mismatch -> message skipped, no dispatch); sh tests/run-all.sh -> "results: 10 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed".

userStories.title: Emit deterministic state transition telemetry fields
userStories.description: As an SRE, I need stable fields for state transitions and verdict outcomes so dashboards and lineage checks can be trusted.
userStories.evidence: coord-fsm-tests.nu 9/9 pass incl. determinism assertions; wired into run-all.sh and qualityChecks. coord-tick.nu routes every FSM transition/verdict through log-transition/log-verdict (single telemetry-record constructor, schema_version v1: schema_version,ts,event,state_from,state_to,task_id,verdict,attempt,reason,message_id). Tests 6-9 assert identical ordered columns per event kind, closed enums for state_from/state_to/verdict/reason, expected sequences for full-cycle/halt/fail-retry/escalate/malformed runs, and run-to-run equality modulo ts/message-id timestamps; renaming or reordering a field makes the gate exit 1.

userStories.title: Persist coordinator state atomically and fail closed on corruption
userStories.description: As an operator, I need state-file writes to be crash-atomic and corrupt state files to halt the tick instead of causing amnesia, so a crash mid-write cannot reset retry budgets or re-dispatch halted tasks.
userStories.evidence: coord-state-atomic-test.nu 5/5 pass via real `nu bin/coord-tick.nu` subprocess invocations: torn (truncated) state file fails closed (non-zero exit, spool byte-identical so halted t-hold is NOT re-dispatched, file quarantined to *.corrupt-*); empty state file fails closed the same way; absent state file still fresh-inits; successful save leaves valid TOML with no *.tmp.* debris (temp+rename); stale tmp from a crashed writer is swept and the intact state is ticked. Wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml and auto-discovered by tests/run-all.sh. Existing suites unaffected: coord-tick-test, coord-double-dispatch-test, coord-fsm-tests 9/9 all green.

userStories.title: Enforce per-executor and global max-inflight rate limits
userStories.description: As a coordinator operator, I need per-executor and global max-inflight caps counted in the crash-atomic state file so one executor cannot starve the others, with overload dispatches deferred under backpressure instead of dropped, slots released on harvest and escalation, stale slots aged out by prune-inflight, and env overrides for tuning.
userStories.evidence: coord-ratelimit-test.nu 11/11 pass: per-executor and global caps enforced via dispatch_deferred_backpressure; harvest and escalation release slots; prune-inflight ages stale entries; inflight survives the atomic save/load round-trip; env overrides (zero cap, per-executor cap, garbage fallback) honored; refusal paths never occupy slots. Merged via PR #117.

userStories.title: Detect dead workers via heartbeats and reap to retry without dropping work
userStories.description: As a coordinator operator, I need piggybacked worker heartbeats with dead marking at a configurable threshold so stalled workers are reaped back to retry instead of dropping tasks, resurrected workers resume cleanly, and halted or pending dispatches stay exempt from heartbeat tracking.
userStories.evidence: coord-heartbeat-test.nu 14/14 pass: piggybacked heartbeats update worker state; dead marking fires at threshold and reaps to retry (never drops); resurrection clears dead marking; halt-skipped and pending dispatches never touch heartbeat state; legacy state files without a workers key keep working; env override sets threshold with garbage fallback; heartbeat/reap paths spawn no extra processes. Merged via PR #118.

userStories.title: Dispatch fleet tasks over opt-in SSH with capability gating and attestation
userStories.description: As a coordinator operator, I need an opt-in SSH fleet dispatch executor so capable hosts can run tasks remotely, with capability gating per host, an attestation reply envelope, halt compatibility, and the MiSTer gaming box explicitly excluded.
userStories.evidence: coord-fleet-dispatch-test.nu 26/26 pass (live 7950x4090pop round trip guarded by SMOLFIRE_FLEET_LIVE=1, skipped by default): opt-in SSH backend defaults OFF; capability gating refuses Network on unknown hosts (S-004); attestation reply envelope carries X-Executor and command_executed claim; halted tasks never dispatch; MiSTer target refused. Design doc docs/FLEET-DISPATCH.md. Merged via PR #114.

userStories.title: Route fleet roles to the real fleet backend inside the tick
userStories.description: As a coordinator operator, I need fleet roles to route to the real fleet backend inside the tick (resolve-executor, state-dispatching before spawn-subagent, identical harvest plumbing) so fleet-capable work actually runs remotely instead of falling back to the old dispatch path.
userStories.evidence: coord-tick-fleet-route-test.nu 6/6 pass (failing-first): fleet role + enabled routes to the real fleet backend via resolve-executor with state-dispatching before spawn-subagent and identical harvest plumbing; disabled preserves old behavior exactly; halt (S-002) and capability-mismatch (S-004) paths intact. Live proofs vs 7950x4090pop: 1-task round trip + 5-task drain. Merged via PR #119.

userStories.title: Support concurrent pending dispatches per executor
userStories.description: As a coordinator operator, I need executor-keyed pending slot lists (fleet 2, jail 2, vm 4) with an extended no-double-dispatch guard (per-slot checks, harvest refusal, crash scan), a kill-switch, and state migration, so independent tasks can fan out concurrently without ever dispatching the same task twice.
userStories.evidence: coord-concurrent-pendings-test.nu 16/16 pass incl. crash injection and same-task-never-twice: executor-keyed slot lists (fleet 2/jail 2/vm 4), extended S-012 guard (per-slot checks + harvest refusal + crash scan), kill-switch, migration, N-slots follow-up. Live peak-2 proof vs 7950x4090pop (5-task fan-out, per-task dispatch == 1). PR #120 OPEN at time of writing (gh pr view 120 --json state => OPEN).
